subject: Hosted API commit tiers & cross-region pricing — follow-up
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Inquiry: commit tiers + cross-region questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profiles looked good for our inference patterns. Before we take the next internal step, legal/finance asked for clarity on two things:

1) Commit tiers and effective per-token discounts on hosted usage for 100M, 500M, and 2B token monthly commitments (we have spiky bursts but want a baseline). Do discounts stack with sustained usage?

2) Region behavior: our traffic will be multi-region (US primary, sizable EU reads for customers, and a small APAC footprint). Do committed tokens apply globally or per-region? If we exceed commit in one region and are under in another, how is overage charged? Any cross-region price differentials we should model for forecasting?

If you have a starter proposal we can circulate (finance + legal), that would be ideal.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform, OrbitAI

[Attachment: initial_usage_samples.csv (csv, 12KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: commit tiers + cross-region questions

Hi Liam — great question and thanks for sending the samples. Short answers up front: commits are global by default, discounts apply to aggregate hosted usage, and overage is billed at the published overage rate for the region where the usage occurred (we explain below).

I've attached a starter proposal and a short note that shows worked examples for your three buckets (100M / 500M / 2B tokens), plus a sensitivity table that models 10/20/30% APAC/EU splits. See attached "pricing_proposal_RDW_OrbitAI_v1.xlsx" and a one-page "region_pricing_notes.pdf".

Key points:
- Commits: billed monthly against a single global commit for your account. Unused commit does not roll to another month but can be reprofiled on quarter boundary with 30 days notice.
- Discounts: tiered on monthly aggregate tokens. The effective per-token price is a weighted average across tiered buckets (we provided examples).
- Cross-region: the committed pool is global. If EU usage causes overage beyond the global commit in a billing month, the overage line-item will carry the EU overage price. That means forecasting should model a slightly higher unit for traffic that runs in higher-cost regions.

I'll walk through numbers with your finance team if you want — Sean here can schedule a short call to run the sensitivity.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_proposal_RDW_OrbitAI_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Inquiry: commit tiers + cross-region questions

Marissa — forwarding Orbit's questions. Quick internal thoughts:

- Price flexibility: for ARR-level deals we can offer an additional 5-10% off published commit discount at the 2B tier with a 12-month minimum spend commitment. Need Rishi's signoff on 2B+ numbers.
- Cross-region ask: finance cares about predictability. If Orbit wants to designate a regional split in the contract (e.g., 70% US, 25% EU, 5% APAC) we can guarantee blended overage rate for that split for the first 6 months; otherwise overages default to region rates.

I attached a redlined pricing grid with suggested counters.

[Attachment: RDW_orbit_pricing_redline_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Inquiry: commit tiers + cross-region questions

Agree with Sean. Thoughtful counter:

- 100M: keep public commit discount table (no special pricing)
- 500M: -7.5% additional on top of published discount, 6-month min run-rate
- 2B: -12% additional on top of published discount, 12-month minimum, and include 3 months of burst credits to accommodate ramp.
- Blended overage: offer a 6-month blended overage option if Orbit commits to a regional split on signature. After 6 months revert to region-specific overage.

Make sure legal reviews the blended-overage language so we don't lock an open-ended exposure. If Orbit pushes for a permanent blended rate, require a higher minimum spend / longer term.

Rishi
VP, Commercial

On Fri, Sep 12, 2025 at 08:15 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Adding this note to keep conversation tight with finance/comm ops.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitai.com>
Cc: OrbitAI Legal <legal@orbitai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed pricing + regional commit option (RDW-ORBIT-2025-09)

Hi Liam — following internal review we've prepared a concise proposal that catches the asks you put forward. Highlights below and attached:

Proposal highlights (summary):
- Global commit model, billed monthly against a single pool.
- Effective per-token pricing examples (monthly):
  • 100M: $0.0085/token (public commit pricing)
  • 500M: $0.0069/token (after -7.5% commercial adjustment)
  • 2B: $0.0056/token (after -12% commercial adjustment + 3 months burst credits)
- Blended overage option: if OrbitAI defines a regional split at signature (example: 70/25/5), Redwood will honor a blended overage per-token for the first 6 months to ease forecasting. Post 6 months region-specific overage rates apply.
- Contractual guardrails: reprofile window quarterly; early termination penalties tied to unused committed months if terminated before the 12-month minimum on the 2B tier.

Attached: pricing_proposal_RDW_OrbitAI_v1.xlsx and region_pricing_notes.pdf which include worked examples and a DocuSign link to the draft SOW/PSA.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw-orbit-draft-PSA (placeholder)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If this looks good, we can convert to a signature-ready DocuSign and have legal look over the blended overage appendix. Would you like Sean and I on a short call with your finance/legal to walk the model?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: region_pricing_notes.pdf (pdf, 8KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrbitAI Legal <legal@orbitai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed pricing + regional commit option (RDW-ORBIT-2025-09)

Marissa — thanks, this is very helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our CFO/GC: 

1) For the blended overage option: can we get an explicit worked example where EU overage is 1.4x US published overage to show the blended math on a 70/25/5 split? That will make signoff much faster.
2) On the 2B tier: curious whether the 3 months burst credits are limited to peak-per-minute or usable for baseline sustained usage (we suspect you'd want to limit to peak).

If you can send those two clarifications (a short worked example + a note on burst credit guardrails) we can move to legal review. Happy to do a 20-minute call if that's easier.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform, OrbitAI
